reason: The cited evidence does not address lattice distortion relaxation, its effect on interatomic spacing, or its link to elastic modulus in HfNbTaTiZr. E1 reports elastic isotropy in a different alloy (NbTaTiV) without discussing distortions, and E2 covers room-temperature tensile properties and microstructure of HfNbTaTiZr without high-temperature or distortion data. The key premises lack specific prior support.
